diagnoses.label: silence smoothing window timestamp misalignment
diagnoses.observable_evidence: silence-detector/scripts/detect_silence.py uses np.convolve(..., mode="valid") then sets silence_end=i where i indexes the shortened smoothed array; it never maps back to original time (should account for smoothing_window offset). SKILL.md describes smoothing_window in seconds but does not warn about the index shift; video-processor/SKILL.md instructs starting pause detection at the returned boundary, so a shifted boundary propagates.
diagnoses.mechanism_anchor: timebase alignment for smoothed energy windows
diagnoses.scope_boundary: Any detector that smooths/aggregates per-second energies and then emits segment timestamps in original seconds
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Cases where smoothing is done with a centered filter that preserves array length and index meaning (e.g., uniform_filter1d with same-length output)
diagnoses.recommended_direction: Introduce an explicit mapping from smoothed index to original-second index (e.g., add offset for valid convolution or switch to same-length smoothing) and document the timestamp convention in SKILL.md so downstream start-time usage is correct.

diagnoses.label: segment combiner lacks merge/de-overlap contract
diagnoses.observable_evidence: segment-combiner/SKILL.md claims it 'Combine multiple segment detection results into a unified list' and notes 'Segments are sorted by start time', but scripts/combine_segments.py only concatenates and sorts; it does not clamp, merge overlaps/adjacent intervals, or recompute duration. video-processor/SKILL.md mandates 'Combine, sort, clamp, and de-overlap all removal segments' and later verification requires 'sorted and non-overlapping', creating a mismatch between combiner behavior and pipeline expectations.
diagnoses.mechanism_anchor: interval normalization (sort, clamp, merge overlaps/adjacency, recompute duration)
diagnoses.scope_boundary: When multiple detectors produce segments that can overlap (e.g., opening overlaps with early pauses) or touch (end==start) and a single removal list is required
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Single-source segment lists already guaranteed non-overlapping and within bounds
diagnoses.target_section: combine_segments() segment aggregation and output construction
diagnoses.recommended_direction: Add a normalization pass: validate numeric start/end, clamp to [0,total_duration] when available, sort, merge overlapping/contiguous segments per a documented convention, and recompute duration as end-start; update SKILL.md to specify the merge convention (overlap and adjacency).

diagnoses.label: pause-detector threshold_ratio semantics inverted in docs
diagnoses.observable_evidence: pause-detector/SKILL.md tuning table says threshold_ratio 'Lower Value = More aggressive, Higher Value = More conservative', but detect_pauses.py marks low energy when energies < local_avg * threshold_ratio; increasing threshold_ratio increases the cutoff, making more seconds classified as low-energy (more aggressive), not more conservative.
diagnoses.scope_boundary: User-facing parameter tuning guidance for pause detection using energies < local_avg * ratio
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Alternative formulations where ratio is applied inversely (e.g., energies/local_avg < ratio) with different monotonicity
diagnoses.recommended_direction: Correct the monotonicity description for threshold_ratio (higher ratio => more aggressive/more pauses; lower ratio => more conservative/fewer pauses) and ensure downstream skills referencing this parameter align.

diagnoses.label: video-processor guidance misroutes segment normalization responsibility
diagnoses.observable_evidence: video-processor/SKILL.md requires 'Combine, sort, clamp, and de-overlap all removal segments' but its own scripts/process_video.py does not clamp or merge overlaps; calculate_keep_segments assumes remove_segments are non-overlapping and ordered, and will produce incorrect keep segments if overlaps exist. Meanwhile segment-combiner currently does not de-overlap either, leaving the pipeline without an implemented normalization step.
diagnoses.mechanism_anchor: pipeline responsibility assignment for segment normalization
diagnoses.scope_boundary: End-to-end silence removal pipeline where multiple segment sources feed video processing
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Workflows where a separate, explicit normalization tool is always run before video processing
diagnoses.target_section: Mandatory end-to-end completion gate steps 3-5 and segment input expectations
diagnoses.recommended_direction: Clarify and align where normalization happens (e.g., require segment-combiner to output normalized non-overlapping segments and state process_video expects that), and add an explicit check step in the guidance to validate non-overlap before calling process_video.

overlay.primary_anchor: interval normalization (sort, clamp, merge overlaps/adjacency, recompute duration)
overlay.composition_issue: Silence boundary misalignment can shift pause-detector start_time, producing segments that may overlap with opening removal; because segment-combiner does not merge/de-overlap and video-processor assumes non-overlap, the pipeline can generate invalid keep segments and fail the downstream verification constraints.
preservation_constraints: Preserve existing JSON I/O shapes (segments array with start/end/duration) so downstream tools remain compatible
Preserve pause-detector algorithm (local_avg via uniform_filter1d and grouping logic) aside from documentation semantics
Preserve video-processor ffmpeg filter_complex approach and encoding settings unless required for correctness

package_assessment.rationale: Defects are localized to deterministic timestamp mapping, interval normalization, and documentation/contract alignment across existing scripts and SKILL.md files; they can be corrected by adjusting smoothing index mapping, adding a merge/clamp pass, and fixing parameter semantics without needing external data or changing the end-task outputs.
